notes.title: Version 0.2.107 Hotfix
notes.content:
Update

[list]
[*] Optimizations have been made to reduce loading times.
[*] It is now possible to batch select materials when upgrading weapons in Crafting.
It is possible to set by rarity.
Materials are selected automatically up to max level.
The same weapon type is automatically selected with priority.
[*] The "Rattata Rattata" voice now changes according to Melody Rank.
[*] The following BGM tracks have been changed from temporary data to recorded sound:
Jolly Hermit's BGM / Dekadon's BGM
[/list]

Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where, when revived from a combat loss while being pushed into a fort, a Ratatan could push enemies out of the way and also move through the fort.
[*] Fixed a bug where the attack trajectory would remain when Dekadon was frozen during a rush attack.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the voices of rhythm commands from being played when many sound effects were happening at the same time.
[*] Fixed a bug where, if set to advanced input, a Ratatan sometimes wouldn't jump when inputting the jump Rhythm Command while pressing buttons with a specific timing.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.2.99 Update
notes.content:
[h2]Highlights[/h2]
[list]
[*] World 3 "Jam Jammer Jungle Journey" has been added.
- Guardian of the Ruins "Rock'n'golem" and "Rafflison" are waiting for you in the Jungle
[*] World 3 Boss "Lord Rosham Bo" has been added.
- Lord Rosham Bo attacks by switching between fire, water, and lightning attacks. You have read how each attack works and utilize the different platforms in the area to defeat him.
[*] Ultra-hard boss Dekadon has been added
- If you enable “Formiddable Enemy Emergence” at the "Oath of Goddess" then an ultra-hard version Dekadon will appear in the Beta.
- He charges at you with his horns or continually attacks with fire attacks. His attack range is quite large with very few openings to do damage. You really have to analyze his patterns or you will lose rather quickly. Make sure you power up your weapons and gear before taking on this big bad.
[*] Advance Controls have been implemented
- You can choose from the previous controls scheme now called "Default Controls and the new "Advance Controls" where you much input mixtures of different buttons rather than the same button.
- You can change the input style from the option menu
- Some button input response voices are currently set to temporary placeholders. These will be updated in future patches. Thank you for your understanding.
[*] New System "Oath of Goddess" has been added
- But adding in different "challenges" to your runs, bosses will drop different items that unlocks your weapon level caps allowing them to get stronger.
- In order to obtain these rare items you need to have the danger level at 1 or higher for them to appear
- Defeating "Lord Rosham Bo" will make an NPC appear in the Rataport hub. Interact with this NPC to open the "Oath of Goddess" menu.
- This feature is only available in offline play during the Beta test but will eventually be selectable in online matches as well.
[/list]
[h2]Battle[/h2]
[list]
[*] Aid" has been implemented
- During multiplayer you are able to revive fallen teammates
- Approach a fallen teammate and press the interact button. This will give them half of your current HP and revive them.
[*] Platforms have been added to the World 3 boss area
- You can get on them by inputting either the Jump or High Jump command
- Once on a platform you can input special commands to have your cobuns jump up on the platform as well.
- By pressing the down input and Jump button you are able to jump off the platform.
- We have adjusted the jump arc based on this new feature
[*] Assault Teshita” has been added to world 2
- ”Assault Teshita” charges forward at the player from the enemy army. They have very high mobility and are good at knocking the player back.
[*] The following Ratacarta have been adjusted:
- Ratacarta: Fire
- Sizzle Guts effect has been changed. Depending on how low your HP is the effect will differ
- Flame Blast has been added. Explosions will happen around your Ratatans for a limited amount of time doing damage to the enemy
- Ratacarta: Water
- Bubble Drop has been added. When you jump a ball of water appears. The power of the ball of water changes depending on your remaining barrier amount
[/list]
[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The player upgrade "Zuntaka Muscle" now occurs during nornal and "perfect" timed attacks
[*] The following Ratacarta have damage adjustments:
- Sizzle Hit/Sizzle Rush/Splash Hit/Splash Smash
[*] Damage for the the Magical Cobun attack Sizzle Hit has been adjusted after you obtain it
[*] Damage for the Unit Skill Sparkle Bomb has been adjusted
[*] The game logic for projects including spears, bows, and bombs has been adjusted
- The base attack power of bows has been increased.
[*] The negative status "Frozen" now lasts 6 seconds instead of 8 seconds and enemies are more resistant to this effect now.
[*] Additional damage has been added to the negative status "Shock" after it ends
[/list]
[h2]Meta game[/h2]
[list]
[*] Cobun Max Plus has been added as an upgrade at the support desk
- By obtaining this you can take up to 12 cobuns with you on your adventures
[*] At the Exchanger you can trade materials from a boss for different materials that same boss drops
[*] Milk has been added to the Exchanger (Cheers!)
[/list]
[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The following selections are available in the options screen
- Game Play: Rhythm Command
- Default : Focus on the timing but utilize the same buttons for actions. And control scheme more suited for new players
- Advanced: A more technical control scheme were you have to focus on timing and pressing the right combination of different mixed buttons. A control scheme more suited to advanced players
- Screen: Rhythm Gauge
- Default : Musical notes will flow from the left hand side based on the beat of the music
- Classic : A slightly transparent frame will appear on the edge of the screen and pulse to the beats
[*] A time-limit has been added to multiplayer matches in-between phases. After a certain amount of time goes by the next phase begins automatically
- The timer begins once all enemies have been defeated in battle phases and begins in the interval phase once any player moves forward
- During the Beta once the time-limit is reached, any player who has not put in an active input will be swapped in with an com-tan (computer controlled character) and moved automatically to the next location. When this happens, the host will have the priority on location selection
- In the Beta the time-limit is universal and affects offline games as well but that will be removed in offline games later
[*] When a Cobun equipped with a Spear, Bomb, or Bow performs a normal attack, the projectile's appearance now matches the equipped weapon.
- Due to this update, a bug has been identified where arrows fired from an unenhanced Bow (without Ratakaruta enhancements) do not display their visual effects. This issue will be addressed in a future patch.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] We have fixed the bug where the number of hits was not being shown when a player obtains [Sizzle Hit]during a Magical Cobun attack.
[*] We have fixed a bug where an overly large amount of damage occurred through upgraded hits from the following Ratacarta: [Sizzle Hit]・[Sizzle Rush]・[Splash Hit]・[Splash Smash]
[*] We have fixed a collision problem that occurred once a Ratatan was defeated in multiplayer play
[*] We have fixed a bug that occurred under certain conditions where The Jolly Hermit would freeze
[*] We have fixed a bug were Cobuns would go off-screen after moving during the Wagoon battle on World 2
[*] We have a bug where the AI behavior breaks if Wagoon is frozen during the battle under certain conditions
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.2.67 Update
notes.content:
[h2]Closed Beta v0.2.67 Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]Highlights[/h3]
[list]
[*] World 2: Bad Day on Yeehawler Mountain is now available.
The boss, Wagoon, has a distinctive attack, such as summoning Bessoons to increase its attack capacity or diving into the sand to attack from below.
Once the Wagoon is defeated, the game can then be played in a circular fashion.
[*] Added Kamonelo functionality to Ratatan
This Ratatan initially enters fights with Assault Cobun and Magical Cobun. The cobun's HP is restored slightly when the rhythm command gathers everyone together, so the troops can last longer if this cobun is utilized effectively.
[*] Added the wand cobun class.
A long-range weapon, the wand's means of attack changes depending on the attributes of any implemented Ratakaruta.
The unit skill allows them to target enemies and gather in one place, or target an ally to boost their attack power.
[/list]
[h3]Battle[/h3]
[list]
[*] It is now possible to input a rhythm command and move the Ratatan except while taking a performance motion.
An occurrence where the Ratatan was unable to act more than expected when failing a rhythm command input, etc., has been resolved.
[*] The maximum number of cobun that can join an adventure has been changed from 6 to 9.
The maximum number of cobun will be expandable at the support desk in the future.
The number of cobun that can be taken by default is currently set in the player enhancement menu, but will be further expanded in the future.
[*] When a cobun is caught by a monster or some other obstacle during the “Align” rhythm command, it will now slip through and return to the vicinity of the Ratatan.
[*] The following enemy long-range attacks now display a marker on the target of the attack:
Pointy Chief / Pinchy
[/list]
[h3]Balance Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the HP, attack power, and action interval of Teshita or other enemies.
[*] The arrows fired by Teshita's bow attacks have been made more visible.
[*] The damage of the Jolly Hermit's great move Frenzied Fish Cannon has been adjusted.
[*] The damage reduction percentage during the effects of the rhythm command "Guard" has been increased. Also, while under the effect of Guard, the player will no longer be knocked back even if hit by an attack that would typically do so.
[/list]
[h3]Meta Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] We have adjusted the amount of experience gained per material when leveling up weapons through crafting.
The amount of experience gained at level 1 has been adjusted, making it easier to level up overall.
[*] We've removed boss materials from the Exchanger that were registered as items that could be exchanged for general-purpose material and other items.
[*] Boss materials are dropped when a boss is defeated (there are multiple drops, one of which is dropped at random), and weapons that can be crafted using those materials also have a low probability of dropping when that same boss is defeated.
[*] What will happen when using the "Skill 1" and "Skill 2" rhythm commands can now be confirmed on the composition screen.
[*] The functions and how they are represented in the Craft Menu, Inventory, and Organization screens have been unified, such as those for equipped and the item lock function.
[*] Added text to the call icons on the inventory, organization screen, and pause menu to indicate which menus can be called.
[*] After the appearance of NPCs at the Support Desk, My Room, Exchanger, and Crafting, will now only describe their facilities the first time you interact with them.
[/list]
[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] The fourth beat in the line indicating beats in the rhythm gauge has been removed.
[*] The Rhythm Command Guide is now displayed when adventuring.
The display can be turned on or off in the options.
[*] Added explanation text for items and choruses that can be acquired during an adventure.
[*] Changed the cobun response voice when failing a rhythm command.
[*]
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Hermit's great move Frenzied Fish Cannon was sometimes triggered at a time where it could not be dodged by the rhythm command.
[*] Fixed a bug in which some tutorials would not play when starting the game again after being interrupted.
[*] Fixed a bug where the attack detection in World 1's Squiddly Pete was set to something unexpected.
[*] Fixed a bug where weapon leveling in crafting was not behaving properly.
[*] Fixed a bug where weapon levels were not displayed correctly in the sortie screen.
[*] Fixed a bug where the appearance of one weapon was replacing the appearance of another weapon during certain movements.
[*] Fixed a bug where certain event progress flags wouldn't appear, making progression impossible when obtaining a cobun early at certain points in the tutorial.
[*] Fixed a bug in which game progression stops when two or more players increase the number of cobun in a multiplayer game using the enhancement item Arms Expansion (used to increase the initial number of cobun that can be taken on an adventure).
[/list]
[h3]Known Issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] A bug where your Ratatan and cobun would get stuck in the Goodie Gate after being hit by an attack that causes them to blow up in battle has been temporarily addressed and corrected to prevent it from occurring.
However, we will need more time to correct the bug so that it no longer occurs at all.
[*] There are other minor problems with the display of text within speech bubbles:
Immediately after a facility is opened, the facility NPC will talk about that facility, but this text may not be displayed correctly.
Lines for World 1 may appear in World 2.
[/list]
